reviews.title: Good value, speed and quality.
reviews.comment: Great quality and fast speeds! I’m glad I purchased this before the AI price boom, as it was very worth the price. 2TB is a great amount of storage to have as a main drive, and the design is clean despite being unable to see it when installed. It’s just as easy as any other M.2 to installs
